steps.task: Add C1 C2 C3 in src/config.js.

In src/store.js assign due on create at 2025-09-01T08:00:00.000Z (urgent 12:00, high 2025-09-02T08:00:00.000Z, normal +72h, low +168h); freeze across PATCH priority; exclude due from CREATED_FIELDS; constructor and TicketStore.open forward responseHoursUrgent (hours 2 -> 10:00).
Add C11 C12 C13 in src/tickets/query.js.
In src/store.js apply overdue as isActive and now>=due before paginate: 11:59:59.999Z empty, 12:00 [T-0002], limit 1 [T-0002], T-0002 in_progress still listed, resolved then closed omitted.
Add C16 C17 C18 C19 in src/app.js.

In src/app.js wire GET overdue=true through parseListQuery second arg into store.list; F-5 ids T-0001,T-0002,T-0004 after T-0003 closed; priority=high [T-0002]; status=resolved []; limit=1 mixed [T-0002]; false/TRUE/1 400; flag off ignored.

In src/server.js createService defaults missing dueTimes to false, passes hours into TicketStore.open (open already forwards them) and dueTimes into createApp; F-3 second life { ...loadConfig({ RESPONSE_HOURS_URGENT: '2', DUE_TIMES: 'on' }), port: 0, workerIntervalMs: 0, dataFile } with a new manualClock at 08:00 keeps T-0001 at 12:00 and assigns T-0002 at 10:00.
Add C24 in README.md docs/api.md docs/operations.md.
Add C25 C26 C27 in package.json and CHANGELOG.md.

criteria.text: loadConfig sets dueTimes true only when trimmed DUE_TIMES equals on (R-7, AD-1). Confirm by: node scratch/proofs/W1-S1.js and focused ID TC-7d; pass when dueTimes is true for ' on ' and on, and false for ON, 1, and unset.

loadConfig reads RESPONSE_HOURS_URGENT HIGH NORMAL LOW via wholeNumber with defaults 4/24/72/168 and names the variable on ConfigError (R-2, AD-2). Confirm by: W1-S1.js and TC-2b; pass when defaults match, '2' yields 2, empty uses 4, 0 is accepted, and nope throws ConfigError naming RESPONSE_HOURS_HIGH.
loadConfig carries a contract docstring naming DUE_TIMES and RESPONSE_HOURS_* (R-2, R-7). Confirm by: grep DUE_TIMES and RESPONSE_HOURS in src/config.js; pass when both names appear.

TicketStore.create assigns due as created plus priority hours at 2025-09-01T08:00:00.000Z (R-1). Confirm by: W1-S3.js and TC-1; pass when urgent is 2025-09-01T12:00:00.000Z, high 2025-09-02T08:00:00.000Z, normal 2025-09-04T08:00:00.000Z, low 2025-09-08T08:00:00.000Z, and hours 0 yields due equal to created.

A ticket's due is set once: PATCH priority and a no-op PATCH leave due unchanged, and due is not a CREATED_FIELDS value (R-3). Confirm by: W1-S3.js and TC-3a; pass when T-0001 stays 2025-09-01T12:00:00.000Z after PATCH priority low.

TicketStore({ clock }) uses default hours 4/24/72/168; constructor and TicketStore.open forward responseHoursUrgent from loadConfig RESPONSE_HOURS_URGENT 2 to assign 2025-09-01T10:00:00.000Z so S9 can pass hours from createService without editing store.js (R-2, A6). Confirm by: W1-S3.js and TC-2a TC-2e; pass when clock-only urgent is 12:00 and both new TicketStore({ clock, responseHoursUrgent: 2 }) and TicketStore.open({ clock, responseHoursUrgent: 2 }) assign 10:00.
TicketStore.create and update carry a contract docstring that due is assigned once (R-3). Confirm by: grep due in src/store.js; pass when the file names due.

ticketRecord and readTicket keep a valid due on version-1 JSON; version 2 is DataFileError; due not-a-time is refused; CLI show prints T-0001 and has no field line due (R-6, R-8, AD-4, AD-5, AD-8). Confirm by: W1-S2.js and TC-8 TC-8c TC-8f; pass when load round-trips due, version 2 throws, not-a-time throws, show stdout has T-0001 and updated, and /^\s*due\b/m does not match.
Persistence record functions name due as an extra ticket field on version 1 (R-6, AD-4). Confirm by: grep due in src/persistence.js; pass when due appears.

TicketStore.open with persistence assigns missing due from created and priority then saves; updated and history stay; outbox pending stays empty; a valid due is not rewritten; CLI list does not write the file (R-6, AD-6). Confirm by: W1-S4.js and TC-6; pass when a high ticket created at 08:00 gets due 2025-09-02T08:00:00.000Z, updated stays 09:00, history length 1, pending [], and CLI list leaves bytes unchanged.

parseListQuery called with one argument and overdue=true still deepEquals { filters: {}, limit: 20, after: null } (R-5, R-9). Confirm by: W1-S5.js and TC-5g; pass when the one-arg result has exactly those three keys and values.
When overdue parsing is enabled, overdue=false, TRUE, and 1 throw InvalidError (R-5, AD-3). Confirm by: W1-S5.js and TC-5e TC-5f; pass when each of those values throws InvalidError.
parseListQuery carries a contract docstring for the optional overdue argument (R-5). Confirm by: grep overdue in src/tickets/query.js; pass when overdue appears.

store.list applies overdue as an extra AND of isActive and now >= due before paginate (R-5, AD-3). Confirm by: W1-S6.js and TC-5a TC-5i TC-5h; pass when at 11:59:59.999Z overdue is empty, at 12:00 it is T-0002, overdue limit 1 after low then urgent is [T-0002], T-0002 stays listed in_progress, and after resolved then closed overdue is empty (a status !== resolved filter would list closed T-0002).
TicketStore.list carries a contract docstring that overdue is an extra AND before paginate (R-5, AD-3). Confirm by: grep overdue in src/store.js; pass when overdue appears.
When dueTimes is true, HTTP POST 201, GET, PATCH, and in_progress transition bodies include due (R-4, AD-5, AD-7). Confirm by: W1-S7.js and TC-4; pass when each body.due is 2025-09-01T12:00:00.000Z.

When dueTimes is omitted or false, HTTP ticket JSON omits due while store.get still has it (R-7, AD-7). Confirm by: W1-S7.js and TC-7; pass when POST 201 has no due key and store.get('T-0001').due is 2025-09-01T12:00:00.000Z.
POST and PATCH bodies that include due answer 400 unknown field: due and leave stored due unchanged (R-3, R-9). Confirm by: W1-S7.js and TC-3e; pass when both requests are 400 with that message.
createApp carries a contract docstring that HTTP due is projected iff dueTimes (R-4, AD-5). Confirm by: grep dueTimes or due in src/app.js; pass when the file names the flag or due.

GET /tickets?overdue=true lists active overdue tickets including F-5, limit 1 mixed dues is T-0002, overdue=false TRUE and 1 are 400, and with dueTimes false overdue=true matches GET /tickets (R-5, R-7, AD-3). Confirm by: W1-S8.js and TC-5 TC-5b TC-5c TC-5d; pass when F-5 overdue ids are [T-0001, T-0002, T-0004] then still those ids after T-0003 closed, priority=high is [T-0002], status=resolved is [], limit 1 mixed dues is [T-0002], and the invalid values are 400.
createApp documents GET overdue=true as an extra AND list (R-5). Confirm by: grep overdue in src/app.js; pass when overdue appears.

createService defaults missing dueTimes to false and hours to 4/24/72/168; a second life with loadConfig RESPONSE_HOURS_URGENT 2 and DUE_TIMES on keeps T-0001 at 12:00 and assigns T-0002 at 10:00 (R-2, R-7, AD-1, A7). Confirm by: W1-S9.js and TC-3c; pass when the first HTTP body omits due, T-0001 stays 12:00, and T-0002 is 10:00.
createService carries a contract docstring naming dueTimes and the hour settings (R-2, R-7). Confirm by: grep dueTimes in src/server.js; pass when dueTimes appears.

README.md, docs/api.md, and docs/operations.md name DUE_TIMES, RESPONSE_HOURS_*, HTTP due, overdue=true, and 1.4.0 rollback (R-2, R-4, R-5, R-7, R-8). Confirm by: grep those names in the three files; pass when each file contains DUE_TIMES and RESPONSE_HOURS, api.md contains overdue=true, and operations.md contains 1.4.0.
CHANGELOG.md has a due-times section naming DUE_TIMES (NFR-2, CONTRIBUTING Releases). Confirm by: grep DUE_TIMES in CHANGELOG.md; pass when DUE_TIMES appears.
package.json has no dependencies and its version is no longer 1.4.0 (NFR-4, AD-9). Confirm by: node -e reading package.json; pass when dependencies is absent and version is not 1.4.0.
Existing behaviour and the existing 117 test titles stay as they are (R-9). Confirm by: npm test; pass when the current 117 sentence-case titles still pass.

headline: W1 step-plan: due times in config, store, persist, query, and HTTP; proved by TC- IDs, npm test, and node --check.
